description: Type the 403 the BYOC infrastructure operations answer for an organization that is not a BYOC organization: {"status": 403, "error": "FORBIDDEN: Not a byoc organization"}. The spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic Forbidden, which is also what a missing permission answers. Observed live 2026-11-12 on POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/byocInfrastructure/validate (a preflight that creates nothing; request id 63deed08-cd37-4987-a1cd-2eed37faf8d2) and on POST .../byocInfrastructure (271876ef-1706-4343-bfb2-a910e9c7058e). The get, progress, tag, update and delete operations answer 404 for an unknown id and carry no error.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The feature is not available to this organization or service: its plan does not include it, it is not enabled for the organization, or it is not set up. The message says which.
